text:
Ethan: Quick sync — need alignment on Q3 GTM targets + PLG experiments. Can we finalize today? Agenda: targets, launch gating for Dedicated tier, enablement needs, top customer asks.
Priya: timeline? marketing push planned week of Jun 14. need final numbers by Fri EOD. :calendar:
Omar: Sales target ask from ops: ARR quota uplift +$1.2M for Q3 if we lock Dedicated pricing and a clear pilot path. Can we confirm commit?
Claire: For launch gating I want these hard criteria: 1) Dedicated capacity SLOs met (p95 latency < 250ms), 2) 3 pilot customers onboarded with success playbook, 3) docs + quickstart + SDK samples done. Anything else?
Maya: Add data residency cert + audit log export for enterprise pilot — at least one EU customer requires it. That is a blocker for their contract.
Diego: Customer success can run 2 pilots in parallel but needs an enablement checklist and 2x workshop sessions. We can do the first workshop week of Jun 21 if docs are ready.
Priya: Marketing asks for feature-level copy and one customer case study (2 paragraphs) by Jun 18 to lock creative.
Omar: On pricing: sales needs clear differentiator between Hosted vs Dedicated. Suggest smaller commit tier (3-month) for pilots to reduce friction. Thoughts?
Claire: 3-month pilot tier is ok but we must not bake in heavy promo pricing. Keep ARR math consistent. Also need fallback plan if Dedicated autoscaling bugs occur — auto-fallback to hosted model with SLA note.
Ethan: Rolling on creative only after we have the pilot commitment language. Can product provide approved copy? Example line: "Predictable throughput for production inference with reserved GPU capacity."
Maya: Approved short copy: "Dedicated capacity with SLA-backed performance and private networking." I'll add compliance bullets in the doc.
Priya: PLG experiments — we should run a gated in-app nudge to upgrade to Dedicated for accounts hitting 95th pct usage. A/B test variants: (A) 30-day trial, (B) pricing offset credit. Metrics: upgrade rate, churn delta, CAC.
Omar: Sales wants telemetry from that nudge in the CRM (lead source + usage bucket). Eng: can we pass usage_segment in the webhook?
Claire: Eng can expose usage_segment in the event payload, but need schema agreement. Example payload snippet: ```{ "user_id": "xxx", "usage_segment": ">95p", "current_plan": "hosted" }``` Please review.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to staging for feature/enablement-docs at 2026-05-29T02:00Z — smoke tests run.
Diego: Enablement deliverables: 1) 60-min pilot runbook, 2) onboarding checklist, 3) troubleshooting playbook. I can draft runbook if product provides steps.
Maya: I'll add runbook steps and compliance checklist to the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.example/q3-dedicated-pilot (working draft).
Priya: Can growth/marketing own the in-app copy and experiment setup? I can coordinate with eng for the rollout window.
Ethan: Yes, Priya please own experiment and creative. Claire/Maya to approve copy and gating logic. Omar to confirm pilot customers list by Tue. Diego to confirm enablement timeline.
Omar: Confirmed — I'll send a list of 4 pilot prospects by Tue morning. Two EU, two US.
Claire: Final asks before we lock: performance sig test results on staging (p95 latency, cost per token), and a signed pilot TOS template. Maya — can legal expedite?
Maya: Legal can fast-track pilot TOS template, cc-ing security for data residency wording. Expect draft by Wed.
Priya: Action items:
- Product: approve copy + runbook (Maya/Claire) — due Wed EOD
- Sales: pilot list (Omar) — due Tue AM
- Marketing: creative + experiment setup (Priya) — due Thu noon
- CS: enablement artifacts draft (Diego) — due Thu EOD
- Eng: event schema + staging perf tests (Claire/eng) — perf results by Wed EOD
Ethan: Great. If we hit these milestones we can greenlight the marketing push Jun 14 and pilot onboarding Jun 21. Anyone blocking?
Omar: Data residency is only blocker for one EU customer; will accept pilot if audit log export available.
Maya: We'll include an audit-log-export flag in the pilot TOS.
Priya: Ok locking this plan. Will follow up with calendar invites and a short brief doc. :rocket:
Ethan: Thanks everyone — will do a final readout Fri.
